stem.en: What is the difference between a bakery's revenue and its profit?

text.en: Revenue is all money from sales; profit is what is left after expenses.
Revenue and profit are two names for the same money from sales.
Revenue is the money left after tax; profit is all the money from sales.
Profit is the money from sales before any of the expenses are paid.

explanation.en: Revenue is the total money earned from selling goods and services. Profit is what is left after the expenses are taken away: Profit = Total Revenue - Total Expenses.

hints.en: ABC Bakery's revenue in March was ₹2,95,000. Was its profit the same?
